question: A hospital uses a high-frequency electromagnetic radiation to detect fractures in bones. Name the radiation and state one reason for its use.

options.A: Gamma rays; they have high photon energy and are used to detect bone fractures.
options.B: Ultraviolet rays; they can pass through bones more easily than soft tissues.
options.C: Infrared rays; they produce heating and show a bone image.
options.D: X-rays; they have high penetrating power, pass through soft tissue more readily than bone, and therefore help reveal fractures.
